title: Dominant finite integral refinements preserve an approximation limit
statement: Let S be a scheme and N a Noetherian approximation of S [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system]. Let X be a diagram on N.I with integral stages, alpha a cone from S to X with dominant components [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], and p:X -> N.D a natural transformation with finite components. If alpha followed by p equals N.pi, then the cone alpha is limiting. No normality or compactness assumption on S and no affine-transition hypothesis on X is needed.

source.place: Tag 0EZJ, proof of Lemma 58.31.9, normal replacement diagram limit claim; Tag 01ZM for finite-presentation morphism descent

proof.text: A finite p_i is locally of finite presentation because its target N.D(i) is Noetherian. Apply exists_map_at_refinement_of_affine_limit to N.D, N.pi, N.isLimit, p_i and alpha_i with the equation alpha_i;p_i=N.pi_i. This gives j, f:j -> i and a:N.D(j) -> X_i, with N.pi_j;a=alpha_i and a;p_i=N.D(f).

The maps p_j;a and X(f) agree after p_i by the naturality of p, and agree after alpha_j by the cone identity and the descended-map identity. The target morphism p_i is separated because it is finite, X_j is reduced because it is integral, and alpha_j is dominant. Mathlib ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated gives p_j;a=X(f).

For an arbitrary cone c:T -> X define its lift to S by the supplied N.isLimit applied to c followed by p. The descended map gives lift;alpha_i=lift;N.pi_j;a=c_j;p_j;a=c_j;X(f)=c_i. Thus it is a cone lift over X. Any other lift over X is also a lift over N after composition with p. N.isLimit.hom_ext proves its uniqueness. These are the three fields of the IsLimit structure.

lean.statement:
theorem isLimit_of_dominant_finite_refinement {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (N : S.NoetherianApproximation)
    (X : N.I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (α : (Functor.const N.I).obj S ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ N.D)
    (hfac : α ≫ p = N.π)
    (hp : ∀ i, IsFinite (p.app i))
    (hX : ∀ i, IsIntegral (X.obj i))
    (hα : ∀ i, IsDominant (α.app i)) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk S α))
